items.html: The educated one will understand from this what is written, that any emergence of new lights and additional worlds is only by the restriction of light. This is because so was the restriction of Ein Sof to elicit AK, and AK to elicit Nekudim, which is Atzilut. All this is very close to the revoking of the kings, and prohibited to elicit in the Peh [mouth], as it is a high place.
